phrases.es: ¿Tiene una habitación en un piso alto?
phrases.en: Do you have a room on a high floor?
Is it possible to check out later tomorrow?
phrases.purpose: ask late checkout without assuming it

phrases.en: How much is the additional charge?
phrases.purpose: make the condition visible before accepting

phrases.en: The air conditioning does not work.
What time can they check it?

phrases.es: Sigue sin funcionar. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.
phrases.en: It still doesn’t work. I need another room, please.
